title: astronidium floribundum
intro: Astronidium floribundum, commonly known as the Hawaiian False Ohia, is a flowering plant species native to the tropical forests of Hawaii. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Astronidium floribundum include reducing inflammation, fighting off infections, and possibly exerting antioxidant effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other phytochemicals that contribute to its medicinal properties.
